agent_priors_used: General prior (not SPIDER evidence): persistent continuation of a single lane's local handoff is a documented failure mode of autonomous research agents - path dependence and local optima can keep a lane mining one claim family after its leverage is exhausted; a concentration/tunnel flag is a warning to re-derive the question from the whole program, not proof of error.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): a benchmark whose comparator arms sit at ceiling (near-100% baseline success) or whose treatment/comparator are not distinguishable cannot produce a discriminating result regardless of sample size; dynamic range must be engineered before execution is paid for.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): a capability prerequisite (capable same-model agent, non-degenerate task bank) should be established once at the substrate level rather than rediscovered as MEASUREMENT_INVALID/blocked across multiple downstream lanes.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): measurement design - positive and negative controls that can actually fire, reachable accept regions, and treatment/comparator distinctness - is a first-class scientific object and is where most 'blocked before freeze' packets fail.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): session-scale corpora cannot support days-to-weeks timescale inference; a negative on the timescale estimand under sparse data is evidence about identifiability, not about the world.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): product plumbing (importing a validated mechanism into the shipped package behind promotion) is qualitatively different from validating that mechanism in a harness, and is routinely the hidden blocker between research PASS and product core.

allocation.comparative_reasoning: LEGACY: DISTINCT_EXTENSION. P2-REPLAY-COST (sha 9687ff787f2d74460bb7006826008852f5b4416b) established credible procedure reuse only at parity (1.002x matched tasks) and withdrew the 8.5x figure, guarding against asserting wall-time savings that were never shown; P2-BLIND-COMPOSITION (sha 017a80aeb9a6759c8f6913a37031ff1616ec1bda) and the archived P2-MIND2WEB result (retrieval 47/176) show that human-route imitation and exact replay are insufficient, motivating parameterized (not literal) inheritance. R2 evidence EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064 already proved the inherited-parameter path is live outside the shipped kernel, but the shipped-kernel importation behind promotion - the actual B1 task - was never attempted by any legacy or prior R2 packet. Not a pointless rerun: main still carries the literal distill path at confidence 0.5, so B1 is genuinely unresolved; the pre-freeze arm-differentiation certificate is the new gate that prior packets lacked.
dependencies: shipped package src/spider/kernel.py and its promotion path
Runtime task-bank certification (B2) and Intel model-capability closure (B3) are required before, not during, the downstream four-arm benchmark
allocation.question: Can Product land the audited parameterized-inheritance capability as the shipped carrier in src/spider/ (replacing the current literal, below-threshold distill_parameterized path), evidenced by a pre-freeze arm-differentiation certificate that includes (i) a known-positive inherited-parameter round trip on a real task, (ii) a known-negative refusal case, (iii) an explicit treatment-vs-comparator contrast showing the shipped kernel treatment differs from the INSTRUCTIONS baseline, (iv) shipped-kernel identity and tests, and (v) promotion-pinned accounting - while explicitly NOT running the four-arm external-agent benchmark until readiness conditions B2 and B3 hold?
allocation.rationale: This is the single highest-leverage blocker in the global audit: the flagship same-model four-arm benchmark cannot test a real treatment until the inherited-parameter carrier is actually shipped, and main's kernel still creates literal candidates at confidence 0.5 below the 0.8 threshold with no live distill_parameterized. Product owns external-agent behaviour and end-to-end economics, and the audit's priority ordering places the shipped carrier (B1) ahead of any mechanism work. The active prefreeze mandate EXP-PRODUCT-38066029940 is the correct vehicle; this allocation supersedes its inherited handoff only by tightening the pre-freeze gate to the arm-differentiation certificate. The explicit prohibition on running the four-arm benchmark now enforces this cycle's readiness rule (B2 and B3 unmet), preventing an expensive cycle whose comparator distinction does not exist yet.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: SPIDER Research 2.0 has accumulated 434 experiments over 10 live claims. Effective state is heterogeneous: C-MEAS-VALID is VALIDATED with a bounded substrate; C-PARAM-INHERIT, C-FRESHNESS and C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY are EXPERIMENTAL; C-LLM-INHERIT, C-WEB-DYNAMICS, C-CROSSSITE, C-PRODUCT-ECON and C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE are HYPOTHESIS. No lane is idle: all six hold an unfinished prefreeze mandate except Physics, whose active experiment is already FROZEN and must complete under its frozen design regardless of this allocation. The global audit is unambiguous that the single missing proof is product readiness, not more mechanisms: a same-model four-arm external-agent benchmark (COLD / INSTRUCTIONS / RETRIEVAL / SPIDER) is the decisive artefact, and it is blocked by three concrete prerequisites - (B1) a shipped, pre-freeze-differentiated inherited-parameter carrier in the shipped kernel path, (B2) a task bank whose cold/retrieval baselines are non-ceiling and whose treatment/comparator distinction exists, and (B3) a same-model endpoint/runtime capable of the minimal multi-step Web task within budget. All six current mandates sit on that critical path (Product B1, Runtime B2, Intel B3, Graph B5-freshness, Frontier acquisition-cost structure, Physics orthogonal observables), and each prefreeze mandate is already the design that clears its own blocker under design-contract v2. Therefore this cycle CONTINUEs all six lanes, using each active mandate's binding direction and requiring the pre-freeze fail-loudly/attainability certificates the prior attempts lacked. The discipline imposed globally: no lane may freeze an experiment whose positive frame is unreachable; no four-arm/economics C-LLM-INHERIT, C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY or C-PRODUCT-ECON benchmark may be funded until B1+B2+B3 hold; freshness work must be labelled guard-discrimination, not a timescale/economic result, because pre-2.0 closed the timescale route on session-scale data; and frontier/Physics must carry strong pre-registered comparators (novelty baseline; no-adaptation baseline).
director_mandate.scout_assessment: The Research Scout ran in DEGRADED SCOUT MODE - no external reconnaissance was available, so its brief could not supply the external competitor/dataset/baseline landscape that would most change a SPIDER decision (e.g. published four-arm same-model Web-agent baselines, or external inherited-parameter/refusal benchmarks). I therefore treated the Scout output purely as a restatement of the current internal question set and validated every candidate against the machine snapshot and Codex, not against Scout authority. The Scout's framing did confirm the three-pronged readiness gap (shipped treatment, non-degenerate task bank, capable same-model agent) that governs the audit's critical path, and it surfaced candidate directions for Frontier (site-native discovery v2) and possible re-openings of C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE and C-WEB-DYNAMICS. I did not adopt the C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE re-opening: the audit explicitly warns that C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE should not be reopened as another isolated micro-benchmark of resolution accuracy, and no lane has produced a product-grounded fork with a sabotage-null. Because Scout is degraded, external-claim verification is deferred: no Scout external claim is used as evidence in this allocation, and the external-capability-envelope check that would benefit from reconnaissance is folded into Intel's mandate as a bounded task rather than trusted from Scout.

inherited_next_question: Now that the pre-freeze dynamic-range certificate is unsatisfiable on the mandatory-discovery deterministic credential-free REST substrate class (B-COLD-RE-DERIVE and B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED both at the 1.0 correctness ceiling at novelty >= 0.5 in families F1 and F2, so the parameterized treatment cannot save http_requests and the frozen cost/novelty test is non-discriminating), the materially orthogonal question is: on a programmatic, budget-stable, credential-free model endpoint (the prerequisite Intel showed is missing, EXP-INTEL-37973264582), can the frozen four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark (same model/tools/budget: COLD vs INSTRUCTIONS vs RETRIEVAL vs SPIDER, with the parameterized mechanism carrier bound to git blob b15ed848 / sha256 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72) produce genuine behavioral variance (COLD success_rate meaningfully below the 1.0 ceiling) and, if so, does the SPIDER arm beat COLD, INSTRUCTIONS and RETRIEVAL on cost per SUCCESSFUL task on an honest counter-only metric (http_requests + retrieval_calls + verification_calls + repair_attempts, excluding latency_ms/1000)? If no such endpoint can be provisioned, the fallback is a credential-free substrate engineered for ASYMMETRIC discovery (multi-task sessions where one-time session/resource/schema discovery is amortized or cached across tasks), tested against the same certificate and the same counter-only novelty-monotonicity criterion; a fourth re-run of the mandatory-discovery deterministic REST certificate is explicitly excluded.
